title: Bounded-degree spanning trees in the prime-sum graph
credit: QED original (archived Nov 2026, restored after re-review).
plain: Join two numbers from 1 to 2n when their sum is prime. Show that every tree on 2n vertices with bounded degree and two equal colour classes can be found inside this graph.
math: Let $\mathcal P_{2n}$ be the graph on $[2n]$ with $ij\in E$ iff $i+j$ is prime ($\mathcal P_{2n}$ is bipartite between odds and evens). Prove that for every $\Delta$ there is $n_0(\Delta)$ such that for all $n\ge n_0$, every tree $T$ on $2n$ vertices with maximum degree $\le\Delta$ and both bipartition classes of size $n$ is isomorphic to a spanning subgraph of $\mathcal P_{2n}$.
